# Asia Maritime Transparency Initiative

> AMTI provides geopolitical analysis, interactive maps, and satellite imagery tracking of maritime claims and territorial disputes in the South China Sea and Asia-Pacific region.

The Asia Maritime Transparency Initiative (AMTI) is a CSIS project that monitors and analyzes China's maritime activities, artificial island construction, and regional territorial disputes through satellite imagery, interactive trackers, and expert analysis. AMTI serves as a primary resource for understanding maritime security dynamics in the Indo-Pacific.

## Key Topics

- South China Sea
- Maritime security
- Territorial claims
- Spratly Islands
- Paracel Islands
- China Coast Guard (CCG)
- Artificial islands
- Satellite imagery analysis
- Interactive maps
- Island trackers
- Maritime disputes
- Geopolitics
- Asia-Pacific
- Vietnam
- Philippines

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://amti.csis.org): Homepage for Asia Maritime Transparency Initiative covering geopolitics and maritime security.
- [About AMTI](https://amti.csis.org/about): Mission, methods, team, and operations of Asia Maritime Transparency Initiative.
- [Interactive Maps](https://amti.csis.org/maps): Interactive maps of South China Sea maritime claims and territorial disputes.

## Island Trackers & Geographic Data

- [China Tracker](https://amti.csis.org/island-tracker/china): Interactive tracker of China's 27 outposts in Paracel and Spratly Islands.
- [Vietnam Tracker](https://amti.csis.org/island-tracker/vietnam): Interactive tracker of Vietnam's outposts in Spratly Islands with satellite imagery.
- [Philippines Tracker](https://amti.csis.org/island-tracker/philippines): Island tracker and geographic data on Philippines' South China Sea territories.
- [Malaysia Tracker](https://amti.csis.org/island-tracker/malaysia): Island tracker and geographic nomenclature data for Malaysia's maritime claims.

## Analysis & Features

- [Analysis Archive](https://amti.csis.org/analysis): Expert analysis on maritime security and Indo-Pacific geopolitical issues.
- [Features Archive](https://amti.csis.org/features): Archive of feature articles on China's maritime activities and satellite imagery analysis.

## Recent Articles

- [All Together Now: China's Militia in 2025](https://amti.csis.org/all-together-now-chinas-militia-in-2025): 2025 analysis of China's maritime militia operations in South China Sea.
- [Eyes on the Prize: CCG Patrols Prioritize Scarborough in 2025](https://amti.csis.org/eyes-on-the-prize-ccg-patrols-prioritize-scarborough-in-2025): Analysis of China Coast Guard patrols near Scarborough Shoal in 2025.
- [Antelope Reef Could Now Be the Largest Island in the South China Sea](https://amti.csis.org/antelope-reef-could-now-be-the-largest-island-in-the-south-china-sea): Article analyzing Antelope Reef expansion and artificial island development.
- [China Relocates PMZ Structure to Weihai Shipyard](https://amti.csis.org/china-relocates-pmz-structure-to-weihai-shipyard): Article on China-Korea maritime tensions and PMZ infrastructure relocation.
